dedupe_keys.name: ebu tr 044 trials tests and projects relating to 4g 5g broadcast supported by european public service broadcasters 2022

description: EBU Technical Report 044 collects trials, tests and projects on 4G and 5G broadcast that European public service broadcasters supported, after they pushed 3GPP to add a broadcast mode for TV services that made it into Release 14 (FeMBMS) in 2017. Its section 2 lists 18 items, among them 5G broadcast at the Eurovision Song Contest, 5G Media2Go and the Hamburg trial in Germany, Vienna field trials, 5G TOURS in Turin and the Aosta Valley stand-alone network in Italy, 5G RuralFirst in the UK, 5G Today, the Finnish WIVE, 5GTN+ and eMBMS projects, LTE-B in rural Norway, the 5G-Xcast project, IMB5 and three Tower Overlay trials in France, Germany and Italy; section 3 covers EBU MTS, ETSI ISG MBC and 5G-MAG. Producer: the EBU Technical Committee, first issued in 2018 and revised in August 2022 (Geneva). Coverage: European trials. Access: a free PDF on the EBU technical site. Licence and cost: no licence text read; free to read. Caveats: the report summarises trials in short entries, so measurement data must be taken from the referenced project reports. Simulation uses: the trial parameters and coverage results give validation cases for broadcast coverage and capacity models. Related records: the 5G TODAY field trial in Bavaria (case_study-5g-today-bavaria-broadcast-trial) and the 3GPP specifications (data-3gpp-specifications).
